task: Generate one polished 9:16 HomeCartel Collection Category Story from the four uploaded images.

critical_input_roles.instruction: Use the uploads strictly in this order and never swap their roles.
critical_input_roles.image_1: Content photo for the top section.
critical_input_roles.image_2: Content photo for the middle section.
critical_input_roles.image_3: Content photo for the bottom section.
critical_input_roles.image_4: REFERENCE ONLY for the three-section structure, HomeCartel logo, typography, placement, and safe area. Do not use its solid placeholder colors as final content.
highest_priority_safe_area_rule: The red rectangle visible in image 4 is an INVISIBLE placement guide only. It is not artwork.
Never draw, copy, trace, recolor, reinterpret, or reproduce that rectangle as a red, white, black, or any other colored border, frame, outline, stroke, margin, or box.
Only the HomeCartel logo and the three product-text blocks must remain inside the red guide's interior with comfortable padding.
The three content photos must ignore the guide as a crop boundary and extend full bleed to every outer canvas edge.
The final image must contain no visible safe-area guide, outer border, inset frame, section border, margin, gap, or temporary placement marker.

composition.sections: Three equal-height horizontal photo sections stacked top, middle, and bottom in that order.
composition.coverage: Every photo fills its complete one-third section edge to edge using proportional cropping. Adjacent sections touch directly with no divider, border, gap, or blank strip.
composition.focal_points: Keep each main product or interior focal point visible and undistorted. Do not cover it with text.
composition.layout_reference: Match image 4's clean editorial balance, logo position, text hierarchy, and safe placement while excluding every guide line and placeholder color.

exact_product_text.instruction: Render only these exact supplied values. Preserve spelling, capitalization, spacing, and wording. Do not infer text from any uploaded image.
exact_product_text.format: In each section, show item_name on the first line in bold and product_type directly below in regular weight.

branding_and_typography.logo: Preserve the exact white HomeCartel wordmark from image 4 at the top-right position. It is a text wordmark 'HomeCartel®'. ABSOLUTELY DO NOT add any house icon, roof symbol, graphic, or emblem next to the logo.
branding_and_typography.text: Use clean minimalist white typography matching image 4. Item name is larger and bolder than product type.
branding_and_typography.placement: Place each two-line text block in readable negative space inside the invisible safe area. Keep it away from products, bright lights, busy details, section joins, and canvas edges.
branding_and_typography.contrast: If essential, use only nearly invisible localized darkening behind text; never create a visible text box or band.

source_fidelity: Keep all three source photos photorealistic, sharp, and high resolution.
Do not stretch, warp, redesign, recolor, replace, or remove products, furniture, lighting fixtures, architecture, or important decor.
Do not add people, unrelated objects, decorative graphics, captions, descriptions, prices, contact details, hashtags, buttons, icons, or extra logos.
strict_prohibitions: CRITICAL: ABSOLUTELY NO HOUSE ICON, ROOF ICON, OR GRAPHIC EMBLEM NEXT TO THE LOGO. The logo must remain the pure text wordmark 'HomeCartel®' matching image 4.
CRITICAL: ABSOLUTELY NO WHITE BORDER, NO FRAME, NO RECTANGLE OUTLINE, NO STROKE, AND NO MARGINS.
Do not copy, draw, trace, or reproduce the guide rectangle line from image 4 as a white border or frame.
The final image must be 100% full-bleed edge-to-edge photos with ZERO visible border lines or outlines.
final_validation: Exactly three equal full-bleed stacked photo sections appear in image order 1, 2, 3.
No visible outer or section border, frame, outline, guide, margin, divider, gap, or placeholder color appears anywhere.
The guide rectangle from image 4 is completely absent and is not converted into a white or differently colored frame.
The logo and all product text remain inside the safe area, while the photos extend beyond it to the canvas edges.
All six product-text values match exact_product_text and no other text is added.
